trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, rounded U-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 65-70 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the horizontal span, with high-amplitude jagged protrusions and deep micro-notches concentrated at the terminal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curves extending from the central peduncle attachment toward the distal tips of the lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme jagged irregularities and physical erosion on the distal terminal points of both the left and right fluke lobes.
